title: s-SNOM Spectrum Calculator
description: A Streamlit application and Python toolkit for calculating normalized scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM) spectra. It models a bulk material or a finite-layer stack with a spheroid tip (GICM for isotropic layers, FIM for uniaxial layers), shows amplitude and phase for several harmonics, and compares calculations with experimental data.
